title: Assignment with a postcondition
statement: Let a limit record, program, execution depth, local-memory function $\mu$, budget $T$, postcondition $Q$, local function $\mathrm{loc}$, index $x$, expression $e$, and integer $z$ be given. If $Q$ holds of the state with local function obtained by updating $\mathrm{loc}$ at $x$ to $z$ and memory $\mu$, and $e$ is safe in the state $(\mathrm{loc},\mu)$ and evaluates there to $z$, with $\mathrm{cost}(e)+1\le T$, then assigning $e$ to position $x$ can execute from $(\mathrm{loc},\mu)$ with cost at most $T$ and yield a state satisfying $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: Q holds after updating local position x to z, with memory μ.
Expression e is safe in (loc, μ) and evaluates there to z.
